name: example_weak_26bit_sequential
note: Classic weak deployment: 26-bit format, sequential numbering, default keys. The archetype PhantomTap flags as CRITICAL.

name: example_strong_37bit_random
note: Hardened deployment: wide 37-bit format, randomized numbering, no default keys, per-card diversified keys.

name: example_h10306_clustered
note: 34-bit H10306 issued in departmental blocks; each block is internally predictable.

name: example_prox_uid_sequential
note: Low-frequency UID-only prox (EM4100-class): no authentication, clonable to a blank in seconds. Sequential numbering.

name: example_campus_multifacility
note: Three-building campus; each building is its own facility code with sequential badge numbers. Multi-facility deployments are common and each facility is internally predictable.
